svg.title: Relative inputs and temporary provider overrides
svg.desc: New tests protect the requested filename identity and configuration restoration after timing. Relative or differing frontend inputs still query the requested file's .clang-tidy configuration. Temporary provider: disable checks, swap back, and verify modernize-use-nullptr is restored.
svg.text: Relative inputs and temporary provider overrides
New tests protect the requested filename identity and configuration restoration after timing.
No module-specific regression for these cases in the parent.
// Configuration lookup must use the requested file, not the frontend input.
// Check-mode timing temporarily overrides tidy's configuration, then
// restores the original provider for subsequent builds.
Relative or differing frontend inputs still query the requested file's .clang-tidy configuration.
Temporary provider: disable checks, swap back, and verify modernize-use-nullptr is restored.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
